messages:
Lena PM: Request: three pilots asked for a safe, repeatable onramp to a 99.99% Dedicated SLA. They want a clear activation rubric we can use at GA. Can we land a product+ops playbook this week?
Omar Eng: propose an "activation token" state machine per customer: NONE -> TOKEN_ISSUED -> SOAK -> FULL_ACTIVE -> REVOKED. API + audit log so toggles are auditable.
Rae SRE: ops gates for SOAK->FULL: 72h soak w/ synthetic load, no Sev1 for 14d, golden metrics present in Console, and automated rollback via token revoke. Also require capacity reservation verification.
Felix Sales: commercial asks: automatic credits on breach but with a hard cap (suggest 3 months). Customers okay with credits unlocking only after FULL_ACTIVE. Some accept partial credits during SOAK.
Anu Legal: need exact measurement window (rolling 30d), credit formula, and carve-outs (scheduled maintenance, customer misuse, third-party outages). Define authority to flip tokens (product + infra lead).
Jin Docs: doc gaps: customer-facing "Activation Token" explainer + internal activation checklist mapping gates to owners. Will draft once legal formula is set. ETA 3 business days.
Lena PM: Product proposal for GA commitment: do not advertise 99.99% publicly until at least one pilot reaches FULL_ACTIVE and automation is in place. For GA public promise cap at 99.95% with token-based upgrade path.
Omar Eng: implementation estimate: state machine + audit API = 1 sprint; router enforcement + reservation tests = 2 more sprints.
Rae SRE: monitoring: tag metrics by customer_id and token_state. Ship dashboard panels (p50/p95/p99, error_rate, slot_util, prewarm_hit). Alert -> auto-revoke if sustained breach conditions met.
Felix Sales: I'll include escrow/credit-cap language in pilot contracts and propose staged payment holdback to limit downside.
Anu Legal: will draft SLA appendix + credit algorithm and post in 48h.
infra-bot: Ticket PROD-99981 created: "Activation token onramp: state machine, metrics tagging, docs"  assignees: @Omar Eng, @Rae SRE.
Lena PM: next steps: Legal -> define formula; Docs -> draft checklists; Eng/SRE -> start PRs for state machine and tagging. Check-in Friday EOD. Ping here with PR links or blockers. :thumbsup:
